blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Classical molecular similarity is central to chemical information systems, yet molecule-language models trained on paired structure-text data do not necessarily organize molecular embeddings according to graded structural relationships. Here we introduce Structure-Aware Guided Alignment (SAGA), a training-only regularizer that uses Centered Kernel Alignment to align neural molecular representations with fingerprint-based Tanimoto similarity, without adding parameters or requiring fingerprints at inference. In MolCA and Atomas, SAGA improves molecule-text retrieval, shifts non-exact retrieval toward closer structural analogues, and increases average scaffold-split property-prediction performance, while molecular description and text-to-molecule generation are improved or preserved in single-run ablations. These results show that established chemoinformatics priors can make molecule-language representations more chemically faithful while retaining their multimodal utility.
blocks.zh: 古典分子相似性是化学信息系统的核心,然而在成对结构-文本数据上被训练的分子语言模型并不一定根据分级结构关系组织分子嵌入. 在这里,我们引入了结构-智能引导对接器(SAGA),这是一种仅培训的规范化器,它使用中枢克内尔对接使神经分子表达与以指纹为基础的Tanimoto相似性一致,而不增加参数,也不在推断时需要指纹. 在MOLCA和Atomas中,SAGA改进了分子-文本检索,将非精确检索转向更紧密的结构模拟,并增加了平均脚手架-分解属性-预测性能,而分子描述和文本-分子生成则被改进或保存在单运行的活化中. 这些结果表明,既定的化疗信息学前科可以使分子语言表达在保持其多式效用的同时更具有化学上的忠实.

blocks.en: 1 Results
blocks.zh: 1 结果

blocks.en: 1.1 Fingerprint similarity as a structural prior
blocks.zh: 1.1 与结构前印相似

blocks.en: Before introducing SAGA, we first examined whether the structural signal used as its training prior captures chemically relevant relationships, and whether CKA can compare those relationships across representation spaces.
blocks.zh: 在介绍SAGA之前,我们首先研究了作为其培训所使用的结构信号是否事先捕捉到与化学相关的关系,以及CKA是否能够对各种代表空间的这些关系进行比较。

blocks.en: As an external readout of chemical relevance, we analyzed 20 TDC ADMET benchmark datasets 18 (7 regression, 13 binary classification), computing pairwise Tanimoto similarity with Morgan fingerprints (radius=2, 2048 bits) under stratified sampling across 10 similarity bins (details in Methods).
blocks.zh: 作为化学相关性的外部读出,我们分析了20个TDC ADMET基准数据集18(7回归,13二进制分类),在分层取样下,用摩根指纹(radus=2,2048比特)计算出Tanimoto的对等相似性,分层取样涉及10个相似性箱(方法的细节)。

blocks.en: Fig. 2 a illustrates this structure-property relationship on representative regression and classification tasks: property differences decrease with structural similarity for regression, while label agreement increases for classification. Across all 20 datasets (Fig. 2 b; individual plots in Supplementary Fig. 1), 15/20 datasets (75%) exhibit statistically significant monotonic relationships ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ). All 7 regression datasets yield strong negative Spearman correlations ( ρ = − 0.78 \rho=-0.78 to − 0.99 -0.99 ) with consistently large Cliff’s δ \delta ( 0.41 0.41 – 0.79 0.79 ), and 8/13 classification datasets show significant positive correlations ( ρ = 0.88 \rho=0.88 – 1.00 1.00 ). The remaining five classification datasets show positive but non-significant correlations, indicating that the structural prior is broadly informative but not uniformly significant across all ADMET endpoints.

blocks.en: We next tested whether CKA can detect relational correspondence between molecular structure and language on ChEBI-20 7 (Fig. 2 c). Matched structure-text pairs yield CKA values near 0.5 0.5 ( 0.504 ± 0.047 0.504\pm 0.047 at n = 100 n=100 ), whereas shuffled pairs stay near zero ( 0.001 ± 0.018 0.001\pm 0.018 ), and this Δ ≈ 0.5 \Delta\approx 0.5 gap is stable across n ∈ { 100,200,500 } n\in\{100,200,500\} . This separation supports the use of CKA as a relational alignment statistic for comparing fingerprint-derived structural relationships with learned molecule-language representations.

blocks.en: 1.2 SAGA aligns neural representations with fingerprint similarity
blocks.zh: 1.2 SAGA 使神经表达与指纹相似

blocks.en: Building on these findings, we used fingerprint similarity as a training-time structural prior for molecule-language representation learning. We refer to this objective as SAGA ( S tructure- A ware G uided A lignment). SAGA adds a CKA-based auxiliary loss that aligns pairwise relationships among neural molecular embeddings with the corresponding relationships among fingerprint representations. This guides the learned molecular space toward structural organization while requiring no fingerprint features at inference time.
blocks.zh: 基于这些发现,我们使用指纹相似性作为分子语言表现学习的前期培训时间结构。 我们将此目标称为SAGA(Stracture-A ware G uided A rigment)。 SAGA增加了一个基于CKA的辅助损失,将神经分子嵌入物之间的对偶关系与指纹表达物之间的相应关系相协调. 这引导了学习到的分子空间走向结构组织,同时在推断时不需要指纹特征.

blocks.en: We integrated this relational prior into two molecule-language models with different molecular encoders and alignment mechanisms. MolCA 12 uses a Q-Former 19 to fuse molecular graphs with language through learned query tokens and cross-attention, and is trained on mini-batches. Atomas 13 directly projects SMILES representations into a shared embedding space using MoCo-style 20 momentum queues; we evaluated both its Base (Atomas-B) and Large (Atomas-L) variants. This comparison tests whether a fingerprint-derived relational prior can be incorporated into both graph- and sequence-based molecule-language representations.
blocks.zh: 我们先将这个关系整合为两个分子语言模型,具有不同的分子编码器和对齐机制. MollCA 12使用Q-Former 19通过学习的查询符和交叉注意将分子图与语言连接起来,并接受过小枪训练. Atomas 13直接使用 MoCo 风格的 20 个动力队列将 SMILES 表示投射到一个共享的嵌入空间;我们评价了它的基(Atomas-B)和大(Atomas-L)变体. 这种比较检验了前指纹衍生的亲缘关系是否可以结合到基于图和序列的分子语言表达中.

blocks.en: Because the two models construct training batches differently, the same structural prior is implemented with model-specific sampling. For MolCA, CKA is computed directly over mini-batches. For Atomas, we maintain a parallel fingerprint queue alongside the existing feature queue, allowing CKA to operate on a larger sample set without increasing the batch size. Full loss formulations are in Methods.
blocks.zh: 由于两种模型构造培训批次不同,因此采用相同的结构前缀,采用模型特定取样。 对于MOCA来说,CKA是直接通过小型炮管计算的. 对于Atomas,我们维持一个平行的指纹队列,与现有的特性队列并列,允许CKA在更大的样本集上操作,而不增加批量大小. 完全损失的表述方法。

blocks.en: We then evaluated whether this training-only prior improves chemically meaningful use of the learned representation space. Cross-modal retrieval on ChEBI-20 7 tests molecule–text alignment, exclude-self retrieval asks whether non-exact hits become closer structural analogues, MoleculeNet property prediction 21 tests transfer to scaffold-held-out molecules, and molecular generation and description examine whether the same prior introduces trade-offs in decoder-mediated tasks.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们评估了这种只培训的事先是否在化学上改进了对所学到的表示空间的有意义的利用。 在ChEBI-20 7测试分子–文本对齐上的交叉模式检索,排除–自检索询问非精确命中是否成为更紧密的结构模拟,MoleculeNet属性预测21测试转移给脚手架持有的分子,分子生成和描述检查之前相同的是否在解码介导任务中引入权衡.

blocks.en: 1.3 Molecule–text retrieval with structural priors
blocks.zh: 1.3 带有结构前身的分子文本检索

blocks.en: We first evaluated molecule–text retrieval on ChEBI-20, where the learned representation space is used directly for nearest-neighbour matching between molecular structures and textual descriptions. SAGA improved every reported retrieval metric for all three backbones and in both retrieval directions (Table 1 ). In Text-to-Molecule retrieval, R@1 increased from 31.48 to 35.82 for MolCA, from 33.56 to 40.44 for Atomas-B, and from 43.15 to 50.97 for Atomas-L. The reverse Molecule-to-Text direction showed the same pattern, with R@1 gains of +2.40, +5.60 and +4.84 percentage points, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们首先评价了ChEBI-20上的分子-文本检索,在那里,学到的表达空间直接用于分子结构与文本描述之间的近邻匹配。 SAGA改进了所有三个主干线和两个主干线的每个报告检索指标(表1)。 在Text-to-Molecule检索中,R@1从MolCA的31.48增加到35.82,Atomas-B的33.56增加到40.44,Atomas-L的43.15增加到50.97. 反分子对图文的方向显示相同,R@1的增益分别为+2.40,+5.60和+4.84个百分点.

blocks.en: These bidirectional gains are informative because the CKA term is applied to the molecular representations; it does not directly regularize the text encoder. The improvement in Molecule-to-Text retrieval therefore suggests that organizing molecular embeddings by structural relationships can indirectly strengthen language alignment through the contrastive objective. This effect was observed in both the graph-based MolCA model and the SMILES-based Atomas variants, indicating that the training-time structural prior is not tied to a single encoder design.
blocks.zh: 这些双向增益是信息化的,因为CKA术语适用于分子表达;它并不直接规范文本编码器. 因此,分子对图文检索的改进表明,通过结构关系组织分子嵌入可以通过对比性目标间接加强语言对齐. 在基于图表的MollCA模型和基于SMILES的Atomas变体中都观察到了这种效果,表明培训时间前的结构没有与单一编码器设计挂钩.

blocks.zh: 1.4 化学模拟物的结构认识检索

blocks.en: Exact-match retrieval does not by itself show whether a model retrieves chemically meaningful alternatives when the paired target is absent. We therefore removed each exact target on the ChEBI-20 validation split and measured Tanimoto similarity among the next-ranked molecules (Fig. 1.4 ).
blocks.zh: 精确匹配的检索本身并不表明当配对目标不存在时,一个模型是否回收了具有化学意义的替代品. 因此,我们取消了ChEBI-20验证的每个确切目标,并测量了下级分子之间的田本相似性(图1.4)。

blocks.en: In MolCA, SAGA retrieved substantially closer structural analogues than the baseline (Fig. 3 a). For Text-to-Molecule retrieval, the mean Tanimoto similarity of the top-3 non-exact neighbours increased from 0.235 to 0.311, and SAGA retrieved structurally closer neighbours for 76.3% of validation queries (one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test, p < 10 − 100 p<10^{-100} ). The same pattern held in the reverse direction, where the Molecule-to-Text top-3 neighbourhood improved from 0.211 to 0.272 and was closer for 73.8% of queries, and extended to both Atomas-B and Atomas-L in both retrieval directions (Supplementary Figs. 8–12). In representative examples, the descriptions associated with SAGA-retrieved neighbours also shared structural-class terms with the query descriptions, providing a text-side view of the same analogue-retrieval effect (Supplementary Figs. 13–15). A per-query scatter analysis further shows that queries with the largest exact-match rank gains tend to move above the structural-similarity diagonal, linking improved retrieval rank to improved chemical neighbourhood quality (Fig. 3 b). These results indicate that the retrieval gain is not only an improvement in paired molecule–text ranking, but also a shift toward chemically coherent analogue retrieval.

blocks.en: 1.5 Scaffold-split molecular property prediction
blocks.zh: 1.5 脚手架分裂分子属性预测

blocks.en: We next asked whether the structurally reorganized embeddings support property prediction for molecules outside the training scaffold distribution. For each MoleculeNet task, we froze the pre-trained molecular encoder and trained only a two-layer prediction head (Methods), so performance reflects information available in the learned representation rather than full end-to-end adaptation. All evaluations use scaffold splits, so the test molecules contain structural frameworks held out from training rather than random compounds from the same scaffold distribution.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来问,结构重组的嵌入是否支持对训练脚手架分布以外的分子进行属性预测。 对于每一个分子网任务,我们冻结了预先训练的分子编码器,并且只训练了一个两层的预测头(Methods),所以性能反映了在所学的表示而不是完全端到端的适应中可获得的信息. 所有评价都使用脚手架分裂,因此测试分子中包含从训练中保持的结构框架,而不是来自同一脚手架分布的随机化合物.

blocks.en: Across eight classification tasks, SAGA increased average ROC-AUC for all three backbones: MolCA (+4.1%), Atomas-B (+2.0%) and Atomas-L (+1.4%; Table 2 ). The gains were not uniform across endpoints, but they were broadly positive, with improvements on 6/8, 7/8 and 7/8 tasks, respectively. MolCA showed the largest average effect, driven by MUV (+21.5%) and BACE (+7.0%), whereas Atomas variants showed smaller but mostly positive transfer. Isolated drops, such as HIV for Atomas-B and MUV for Atomas-L, indicate that the structural prior is not universally beneficial for every endpoint. Nevertheless, the positive average gains under scaffold splits suggest that the training-time prior improves representations in settings that require transfer to structurally distinct molecules, complementing the analogue-retrieval results above.
blocks.zh: 在8个分类任务中,SAGA增加了所有3个主干线的平均ROC-AUC:MollCA(+4.1%)、Atomas-B(+2.0%)和Atomas-L(+1.4%);表2。 各个端点的成绩并不一致,但总体上是积极的,分别改进了6/8、7/8和7/8任务。 MollCA表现出最大的平均效应,由MUV(+21.5%)和BACE(+7.0%)驱动,而Atomas变体显示的转移较小,但大多为正转移。 孤立的下降,如Atomas-B的艾滋病毒和Atomas-L的MUV,表明结构前缀并非对每一个终点都普遍有利。 尽管如此,脚手架拆分下的平均正收益表明,培训时间前改进了在需要转移到结构不同的分子的环境下的表述,补充了上述类似检索结果。

blocks.en: 1.6 Molecular generation and description
blocks.zh: 1.6 分子生成和描述

blocks.en: Because SAGA reorganizes the embedding space, we next asked whether this change disrupts tasks whose outputs are produced through a decoder rather than read directly from nearest-neighbour geometry. We evaluated the SAGA ablation on two generation settings supported by the underlying backbones: de novo molecular generation from text in Atomas, and molecular description generation from structure in MolCA and Atomas.
blocks.zh: 由于SAGA重组嵌入空间,我们接下来询问这个变化是否干扰了其输出通过解码器产生的任务,而不是直接从最近的邻居几何读取. 我们评估了由基础骨干支撑的两代结构的SAGA激发:从Atomas的文本中重新生成分子,从MolCA和Atomas的结构中生成分子描述。

Bounded metrics are multiplied by 100, whereas Levenshtein is reported as raw edit distance. Text → \rightarrow Molecule generation is evaluated for Atomas on the validation split. Molecule → \rightarrow Text description is evaluated on the MolCA test split and the Atomas validation split. Best results within each model pair are shown in bold .

blocks.en: In these single-run ablations, the effect is task-dependent but shows no material trade-off (Table 3 ). Description generation improves for MolCA and Atomas-L, while Atomas-B remains essentially unchanged, consistent with the fact that decoder-mediated outputs can absorb part of the representational change introduced by SAGA. In text-to-molecule generation, SAGA slightly improves BLEU and fingerprint similarity for Atomas-B and preserves the stronger Atomas-L generator, including unchanged validity. Thus, the largest gains occur when downstream tasks directly consume the reorganized embedding geometry, while decoder-mediated generation is improved or largely maintained rather than degraded.
blocks.zh: 在这些单运行的模拟中,效果取决于任务,但没有显示物质上的权衡(表3)。 MOLCA和Atomas-L的描述生成得到改善,而Atomas-B基本上保持不变,这与解码介质输出能够吸收SAGA引入的部分代表变化相一致. 在文本对分子生成中,SAGA对Atomas-B略微改进了BLEU和指纹相似性,并保留了更强的Atomas-L生成器,包括不变的有效性. 因此,最大的收益发生在下游任务直接消耗重组的嵌入几何,而代码介质生成则得到改善或基本维持而不是退化。

blocks.en: 1.7 Sensitivity of structural prior integration
blocks.zh: 1.7 结构前一体化的敏感性

blocks.en: We next examined how the structural prior depends on three design choices: regularization weight ( λ \lambda ), fingerprint type and CKA sample size ( n n ). Full validation tables and training curves are provided in Supplementary Note 1, Supplementary Tables 1–3 and Supplementary Figs. 2–4.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来审查结构前置如何取决于三种设计选择:正态权重(QQ\ lambda),指纹类型和CKA样本大小(n n ). 完整的审定表和培训曲线载于补充说明1、补充表1-3和补充图。 2–4 (英语).

blocks.en: Regularization weight produced a capacity-dependent response. MolCA improved up to λ = 100 \lambda=100 (+11.9% R@1) but decreased at λ = 1000 \lambda=1000 , whereas Atomas-B also peaked at λ = 100 \lambda=100 (+20.5% R@1) and Atomas-L remained robust at larger weights. We therefore use λ = 100 \lambda=100 as the default setting, which gives strong gains across all three backbones while avoiding the high-weight regime that destabilizes the smaller or more constrained models.
blocks.zh: 规范化重量产生了一种依赖能力的反应。 MoloCA改进到 = 100\lambda= 100 (+11.9% R@1),但在 = 1000\lambda= 1 000 时有所下降,而 Atomas-B 也达到 = 100\lambda= 100 (+20.5% R@1) 的峰值, Atomas-L 在较大重量时仍然坚挺. 因此,我们使用QQ=100\lambda=100作为默认设置,这给所有三个骨干都带来了巨大的收益,同时避免了破坏较小或更受制约模式的稳定的高重量政权.

blocks.en: Fingerprint type showed that the best structural target depends on the molecular encoder. Morgan fingerprints performed best for the graph-based MolCA model, whereas MACCS keys were better for the SMILES-based Atomas variants (Atomas-L, 53.32% versus 50.97% R@1 with Morgan; Atomas-B, 41.92% versus 40.44%). RDKit topological fingerprints were consistently weaker and degraded MolCA, suggesting that path-based similarity provides a less compatible relational signal for these molecule-language objectives. This model-dependent behaviour indicates that the structural prior is not an arbitrary auxiliary target; its benefit depends on compatibility between the fingerprint relation and the molecular encoder.
blocks.zh: 指纹类型显示最佳结构目标取决于分子编码器. Morgan指纹在基于图表的MolyCA模型中表现最好,而MACCS的密钥在基于SMILES的Atomas变体中表现较好(Atomas-L,53.32%与Morgan的50.97%R@1;Atomas-B,41.92%与40.44%)。 RDKit地形指纹一直较弱且退化的MolyCA,这表明基于路径的相似性为这些分子语言目标提供了不太兼容的关系信号. 这种依赖模型的行为表明结构前置不是任意的辅助目标;其好处取决于指纹关系和分子编码器之间的兼容性.

blocks.en: The CKA sample size also showed an intermediate optimum. MolCA gains were stable across batch sizes despite a lower large-batch baseline, while Atomas-B and Atomas-L performed best around n = 128 n=128 and lost benefit at very large sample sizes. This pattern suggests that the CKA target should be large enough to estimate structural relationships reliably but not so large that it imposes overly detailed pairwise constraints during training.
blocks.zh: CKA样本尺寸也显示出中间最佳. 尽管大批量基线较低,但不同批量的摩洛碳化物增益是稳定的,而阿托马斯-B和阿托马斯-L在n=128n=128左右表现最好,在非常大的样本规模上失去效益。 这种模式表明,CKA目标应足够大,足以可靠地估计结构关系,但规模不大,以致在培训期间造成过于详细的双向制约。

blocks.en: 1.8 Representation-space interpretation
blocks.zh: 1.8 代表空间解释

blocks.en: Finally, we asked whether the downstream improvements are accompanied by a measurable reorganization of representation space. We analyzed molecule and text embeddings using CKA, clustering metrics and t-SNE visualization (Fig. 4 ); additional model-specific visualizations and scaffold-clustering metrics are provided in Supplementary Note 2, Supplementary Figs. 5–7 and Supplementary Table 4.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们问下游的改善是否伴随着对代表空间的可衡量重组。 我们利用CKA、集群度量衡和T-SNE可视化(图4)分析了分子和文本嵌入;补充说明2、补充度量衡中提供了额外的针对模型的可视化和脚手架集群度量。 5-7和补充表4。

blocks.en: The primary effect of SAGA was to align molecular embeddings with fingerprint structure. Molecule–fingerprint CKA increased for all backbones (MolCA, 0.452 → 0.688 0.452\rightarrow 0.688 ; Atomas-B, 0.595 → 0.784 0.595\rightarrow 0.784 ; Atomas-L, 0.581 → 0.788 0.581\rightarrow 0.788 ), and MolCA showed a marked improvement in Tanimoto-cluster separation (Calinski–Harabasz, 15.6 → 44.1 15.6\rightarrow 44.1 ). Weight and fingerprint analyses in representation space mirrored the sensitivity results above: stronger structural alignment was beneficial only within a model-dependent regime, and fingerprint preferences followed the MolCA/Atomas encoder split.
blocks.zh: SAGA的主要作用是使分子嵌入与指纹结构一致. 分子 - 指纹 所有骨干都增加了CKA(MolCA, 0452 ~ 0.688 0.452 右 0.688; Atoms-B, 0.595 ~ 0.784 0.595 右倾 3 Atomas-L, 0.581 — 0.788 0.581\ 右翼0.788)和MOLCA显示,Tanimoto-集群分离明显改善(Calinski-Harabasz, 15.6 — 44.1 15.6\右翼 44.1)。 代表空间的重量和指纹分析反映了上述敏感性结果:只有在一个依赖模型的制度内,加强结构调整才有益,指纹偏好遵循了MollCA/Atomas编码器的分裂。

blocks.en: The reorganization also propagated to the text side through contrastive training. Text–fingerprint CKA increased for MolCA, Atomas-B and Atomas-L, despite the CKA loss being applied to molecular representations. Molecule–text CKA remained stable or improved for MolCA and Atomas-L and only marginally decreased for Atomas-B, indicating that structural organization did not disrupt cross-modal alignment.
blocks.zh: 重组还通过对比培训向文本方面进行宣传。 尽管CKA损失适用于分子表达,但MOLCA、Atomas-B和Atomas-L的文本-指印CKA有所增加。 分子-文本CKA对于MOLCA和Atomas-L来说保持稳定或改进,对于Atomas-B来说则略有减少,这表明结构组织没有干扰跨模式的对齐。

blocks.en: The same trend was visible under structural criteria not used directly by the training loss. When embeddings were grouped by Murcko scaffold identity, Calinski–Harabasz scores improved across all models (MolCA +341%, Atomas-B +70%, Atomas-L +73%), and Silhouette became positive for every backbone. Together, these analyses suggest that SAGA does not merely imprint the exact fingerprint-similarity target, but induces a broader chemically organized representation space that helps explain the retrieval and property-prediction gains reported above.
blocks.zh: 在培训损失没有直接使用的结构标准下,同样的趋势是显而易见的。 当嵌入物被Murcko脚手架身份组合时,卡林斯基–哈拉巴斯兹在所有模型中的得分都有所改善(MolCA+341%,Atomas-B+70%,Atomas-L+73%),Silhouette对每个骨干都变得正面. 这些分析表明,SAGA不仅印有精确的指纹-相似性目标,而且诱导了更广泛的化学结构化代表空间,有助于解释上文所报告的检索和财产预测收益。

blocks.en: 2 Discussion
blocks.zh: 2 讨论情况

blocks.en: We have shown that a classical chemoinformatics prior can improve molecule–language representation learning when used as a training-time relational target. SAGA transfers fingerprint-based structural similarity into neural molecular embeddings through CKA regularization, without adding trainable parameters or requiring fingerprints at inference. Across MolCA and Atomas backbones, this prior improved molecule–text retrieval, shifted non-exact retrieval toward closer chemical analogues, increased average scaffold-split property performance, and improved or preserved performance in decoder-mediated generation ablations.
blocks.zh: 我们已表明,在作为培训时间关系目标时,先用古典化信息学可以改善分子语言表现学习。 SAGA通过CKA正规化将指纹结构相似性转移至神经分子嵌入,而不增加可训练参数,也不需要推断指纹. 在整个MOLCA和Atomas的骨干中,这种先前改进的分子-文本检索,将非精确检索转向更接近化学模拟,提高了平均脚手架-分层财产性能,以及改进或保留了代码介质生成堆积中的性能。

blocks.en: The main implication for chemical information modeling is that fingerprint similarity can be used as more than an external descriptor or post hoc retrieval score. By aligning pairwise relationships rather than concatenating descriptor features, SAGA preserves the role of fingerprints as an interpretable structural prior while allowing the deployed model to operate only with neural embeddings. This distinction matters for molecule–language systems: the same representation can support paired molecule–text retrieval and, when the exact target is removed, retrieve structurally closer analogues. The scaffold-split property results further suggest that this structural organization is not confined to ChEBI-20 retrieval, but can transfer to held-out molecular frameworks in downstream property prediction.
blocks.zh: 化学信息建模的主要含义是指纹相似性可以比外部描述符或后特设检索分数多使用. SAGA通过对双向关系进行对齐,而不是对描述符特征进行拼接,保留了指纹作为可解释结构前的作用,同时允许部署的模型仅使用神经嵌入操作. 这种区分对分子语言系统很重要:同样的表示可以支持配对的分子-文本检索,在去除确切的目标时,可以检索结构上更接近的模拟. 脚手架-分裂的属性结果进一步表明,这种结构组织并不局限于ChEBI-20检索,而是可以在下游属性预测中转移到被搁置的分子框架.

blocks.en: The results also clarify that structural-prior integration is a compatibility problem, not a single fixed recipe. Morgan fingerprints were most effective for the graph-based MolCA model, whereas MACCS keys were stronger for the SMILES-based Atomas variants, consistent with their different sensitivities to circular substructures and curated functional-group patterns 22 . The regularization strength and CKA sample size were likewise model-dependent, with intermediate or capacity-adjusted settings performing best. Representation analyses supported this interpretation: molecule–fingerprint CKA increased across backbones, structural organization propagated to the text side through contrastive training, and scaffold-based clustering improved even though scaffold labels were not used by the loss. These observations suggest that the gains reflect a broader reorganization of molecule–language representations around chemically meaningful similarity, rather than simple fitting to one fingerprint table.
blocks.zh: 结果还澄清了结构前融合是一个兼容性问题,而不是一个固定的食谱. Morgan指纹对基于图表的MOLCA模型最为有效,而MACCS键对基于SMILES的Atomas变体则更为强大,这与它们对于圆形亚结构的不同敏感度和被调整的功能组模式一致 22 . 正规化强度和CKA样本规模同样取决于模型,中间或能力调整的设置表现最好。 代表性分析支持这一解释:分子-指印CKA在骨干上增加,结构组织通过对比性训练传播到文本侧面,脚手架上的集群也得到改善,即使脚手架的标签没有被丢失使用。 这些意见表明,这些收益反映了分子语言表达形式围绕化学上有意义的相似性进行更广泛的重组,而不是简单地适合一个指纹表。

blocks.en: The current study focuses on two-dimensional fingerprint-derived priors in molecule–language models evaluated on retrieval, property prediction and generation benchmarks. The results do not establish that the same prior will be optimal for tasks dominated by three-dimensional conformation, target-specific binding mechanisms or prospective experimental validation. Generation results should also be interpreted as robustness evidence: the largest gains occur when downstream tasks directly consume the embedding geometry, whereas decoder-mediated tasks are improved or largely maintained rather than uniformly enhanced. Future work should therefore examine how to select or combine relational priors for different molecular encoders and chemical tasks, including priors that capture three-dimensional or target-aware relationships when those mechanisms are central to the application.
blocks.zh: 目前的研究侧重于分子语言模型中二维指纹来源的前科,这些模型评价了检索、财产预测和生成基准。 结果没有确定,对于以三维配对,目标特定约束机制或未来实验验证为主的任务,同一前作将是最佳的. 生成结果也应被解释为可靠证据:最大的收益发生在下游任务直接消耗嵌入几何,而解码媒介任务则得到改进或基本维持,而不是统一增强。 因此,今后的工作应审查如何为不同的分子编码器和化学任务选择或合并关系前科,包括当这些机制是应用的核心时,如何捕捉三维或目标认识关系的前科。

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview of SAGA
blocks.zh: 3.1 SAGA概览

blocks.en: Standard contrastive learning for molecular representations relies on binary supervision: matched pairs are pulled together while unmatched pairs are pushed apart. However, this objective ignores the continuous spectrum of molecular similarity—two molecules may share significant substructural overlap yet be treated identically to completely unrelated pairs. SAGA (Structure-Aware Guided Alignment) addresses this by aligning relational structures rather than individual representations. Using Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA), we measure how well the pairwise similarity patterns in the neural embedding space match those in the fingerprint space. This alignment is enforced through SAGA Regularization, an auxiliary regularization term added to the base contrastive loss at training time; no architectural changes to the underlying model are required, and SAGA introduces no additional trainable parameters. As a result, it can be applied as a drop-in to existing molecule-language frameworks regardless of their encoder type.
blocks.zh: 分子表达的标准对比性学习依赖于二进制监督:匹配对子被拉在一起,而未匹配对子被推开. 然而,这个目标忽略了分子相似性的连续频谱——两分子可能具有显著的亚结构重叠,但处理方式却与完全无关的对子相同. SAGA(Stracture-Awared Guided Agreement)通过调整关系结构而不是个人表述来解决这个问题. 使用中枢核对齐(CKA),我们测量神经嵌入空间中的对偶相似性模式如何与指纹空间中的对偶相似。 这种对齐是通过SAGA规范化执行的,这是训练时在基础对比性损失中添加的辅助规范化术语;不需要对基础模型进行建筑改变,SAGA引入了不额外的可训练参数. 因此,无论编码器类型如何,都可以作为滴入法应用于现有的分子语言框架.

blocks.en: An overview of the proposed method is illustrated in Fig. 1 . Given a sample of molecules, we construct Gram matrices capturing pairwise similarities in both spaces and encourage their structural alignment through CKA-based regularization. The remainder of this section is organized as follows. Section 3.2 summarizes dataset curation, split usage and leakage-control procedures. Section 3.3 formalizes the two representation spaces and Section 3.4 introduces the CKA-based relational alignment objective that together define SAGA. Section 3.5 presents the preliminary analyses that validate its underlying assumptions. Section 3.6 describes the overall training objective and its integration with the two baseline models (MolCA and Atomas). Section 3.7 details the baseline pre-training setup, and Sections 3.8 – 3.12 describe the evaluation protocols used for cross-modal retrieval, structural-neighbour retrieval analysis, molecular property prediction, molecular generation and description, and representation space analysis.
blocks.zh: 图1概述了拟议方法。 考虑到一些分子的样本,我们构建了Gram矩阵,捕捉两个空间的对偶相似性,并通过基于CKA的规范化鼓励它们的结构对齐. 本节其余部分编排如下. 第3.2节概述了数据集的整理、分用途和渗漏控制程序。 第3.3节正式确定了两个代表空间,第3.4节提出了基于CKA的关系调整目标,共同界定SAGA. 第3.5节介绍了验证其基本假设的初步分析。 第3.6节介绍了总体培训目标及其与两个基线模型(MolCA和Atomas)的结合。 第3.7节详细介绍了培训前的基线设置,第3.8至3.12节介绍了用于跨模式检索、结构-邻居检索分析、分子属性预测、分子生成和描述以及表示空间分析的评价协议。

blocks.en: 3.2 Data curation and dataset splits
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 数据整理和数据集分割

blocks.en: All analyses use public molecular datasets or source corpora. The molecule-language pre-training corpus was assembled from PubChem following the Atomas/MoleculeSTM data-collection pipeline. Briefly, raw SMILES-text pairs were merged by PubChem CID, filtered by minimum description length, and screened to remove SMILES that overlapped with ChEBI-20 and PCdes before pre-training. The resulting curated PubChem-derived corpus was used under matched conditions for each baseline and its SAGA counterpart, so comparisons isolate the effect of the structural-prior regularizer rather than differences in training data.
blocks.zh: 所有分析都使用公共分子数据集或源氏体. 分子语言培训前教程是在Atomas/MoleculeSTM数据收集管道之后从PubChem组装而成的。 简而言之,原始的SMILES-文本对由PubChem CID合并,通过最小描述长度过滤,经过筛选去除在预训前与ChEBI-20和PCdes重叠的SMILES. 由此产生的PubChem衍生物在与每个基线和SAGA对应物相匹配的条件下使用,因此比较分离了结构前常态化器的效果,而不是培训数据的差异。

blocks.en: ChEBI-20 was used for molecule–text retrieval, structural-neighbour retrieval, molecular description generation and text-to-molecule generation. We retained the published train/validation/test split. Cross-modal retrieval, exclude-self structural-neighbour retrieval, Atomas text-to-molecule generation and Atomas description-generation metrics were evaluated on the validation split, whereas MolCA description generation was evaluated on the ChEBI-20 test split following the native MolCA evaluation recipe. In the exclude-self retrieval analysis, the paired ground-truth entry was removed from the candidate ranking before computing non-exact neighbours, but the same validation query set and model scores were otherwise used.
blocks.zh: ChEBI-20被用于分子–文本检索,结构–邻居检索,分子描述生成和文本–分子生成. 我们保留了已公布的列车/验证/测试分机. 在验证分解上对跨模式检索、排除自结构-邻接检索、Atomas文本对分子生成和Atomas描述生成度量衡进行了评价,而在原生的MOLCA评价分解后,CHEBI-20测试分解上对MOLCA描述生成进行了评价。 在排除-自我检索分析中,在计算非精确邻居之前,将配对的地面真实条目从候选排名中删除,但另外使用了相同的验证查询集和模型分数.

blocks.en: Property prediction used eight MoleculeNet classification datasets with benchmark scaffold splits. Molecular encoders were frozen, and only the prediction head was trained on property labels; no MoleculeNet labels were used during molecule-language pre-training or during SAGA regularization. The TDC ADMET datasets were used only for the diagnostic structure-property analysis of fingerprint similarity and were not used to train or tune the molecule-language models. SMILES strings, labels and split definitions were used as provided by the corresponding benchmark or by the native baseline preprocessing pipeline, and molecular fingerprints, Tanimoto similarities and validity checks were computed with RDKit as described below.
blocks.zh: 财产预测使用了8个MoleculeNet分类数据集,有基准脚手架分割. 分子编码器被冻结,只有预测头接受了关于属性标签的培训;在分子语言预训或SAGA规范化期间没有使用分子网络标签. TDC ADMET数据集仅用于指纹相似性的诊断结构-财产分析,不用于训练或调谐分子语言模型. 使用SMILES字符串、标签和拆分定义是按相应的基准或原生基线预处理管道提供的,分子指纹、Tanimoto相似度和有效性检查与RDKit计算如下。

blocks.en: 3.3 Molecular representation spaces
blocks.zh: 3.3 分子表示空间

blocks.en: Atomas employs MoCo-style 20 contrastive learning with a momentum-updated queue for negative sampling. Because large models such as Atomas cannot afford arbitrarily large training batches, we decouple the CKA sample set from the training batch: we maintain a separate molecular queue that stores fingerprint and corresponding latent representations alongside the existing feature queue, and compute ℒ SAGA \mathcal{L}_{\text{SAGA}} over n n samples drawn from this queue. This allows the CKA sample size n n to be tuned independently of the training batch size, which remains fixed at 16 following the original implementation.

blocks.en: 3.7 Baseline models and pre-training
blocks.zh: 3.7 基线模型和培训前

blocks.en: We evaluate SAGA on two representative molecular representation learning frameworks. MolCA 12 is a graph-language modeling framework that employs a Q-Former 19 to bridge 2D molecular graphs with language models. Atomas 13 is a hierarchical adaptive alignment framework that unifies SMILES and text representations through a shared encoder architecture; we evaluate both Base and Large variants.
blocks.zh: 我们评价SAGA的两个具有代表性的分子表达学习框架. MollCA 12是一个图形语言模型框架,它使用Q-Former 19将2D分子图与语言模型连接起来. Atomas 13是一个分级的适应性调整框架,通过共享编码器架构统一了SMILES和文本表述;我们评价Base和大变体。

blocks.en: We assemble a unified pre-training corpus directly from PubChem by following the data collection pipeline of Atomas 13 , which itself adapts the MoleculeSTM framework 9 . Starting from 408,250 raw SMILES-text pairs, we merge entries sharing the same PubChem CID, apply a minimum description length filter (18 characters), and remove all molecules whose SMILES overlap with the downstream evaluation datasets (ChEBI-20 and PCdes) to prevent data leakage. The resulting dataset contains 34,365 unique molecule-text pairs and is used to pre-train both MolCA and Atomas, under both their original training objective (baseline) and with the added SAGA regularizer, so that any performance difference can be attributed solely to SAGA.
blocks.zh: 我们通过Atomas 13的数据收集管道,直接从PubChem 组装一个统一的预培训程序,而Atomas 13的数据收集程序本身就适应了分子STM框架. 9 (英语). 从408,250个原始的SMILES-文本对开始,我们合并了共享同一PubChem CID的条目,采用了最小描述长度过滤器(18个字符),并移除了所有SMILES与下游评价数据集(CHEBI-20和PCdes)重叠的分子,以防止数据泄露. 由此形成的数据集包含34,365个独特的分子文字对,并用于在MollCA和Atomas的原始训练目标(基线)下以及加上的SAGA正则器下进行预训,这样任何性能差异都可以完全归因于SAGA.

blocks.en: All pre-training runs are executed using the official open-source implementations of MolCA 12 and Atomas 13 , with the SAGA loss integrated into each training pipeline. For the main retrieval, property-prediction and representation analyses, SAGA uses Morgan fingerprints with λ = 100 \lambda=100 unless otherwise specified. MolCA computes CKA over mini-batches of 64 molecules, so the CKA sample size is n = 64 n=64 . Atomas uses a training batch size of 16 and computes CKA over a separate fingerprint queue of n = 128 n=128 samples. Generation-specific checkpoint provenance is described in Section 3.11 , and ablation experiments vary λ \lambda , fingerprint type and CKA sample size as reported in Supplementary Note 1. We otherwise follow the default hyperparameter settings of each baseline (optimizer, learning rate schedule, and base contrastive loss).

blocks.en: 3.8 Cross-modal retrieval evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.8 跨模式检索评价

blocks.en: We evaluate cross-modal retrieval on ChEBI-20 7 , which contains approximately 33,000 molecule-description pairs under an 80%/10%/10% train/validation/test split. Retrieval is performed over the validation split, yielding a candidate pool of approximately 3,300 pairs.

blocks.en: We follow the native scoring protocol of each baseline: molecular and text embeddings are extracted from the respective encoders, and a similarity matrix is constructed between all query-candidate pairs over the full validation pool. For Atomas, embeddings are L 2 L_{2} -normalized and scored by dot product, equivalent to cosine similarity. blocks.en: 3.9 Structural-neighbour retrieval analysis
blocks.zh: 3.9 结构-邻国检索分析

blocks.en: To test whether retrieval gains correspond to chemically closer non-exact neighbours, we performed an exclude-self structural-neighbour analysis on the ChEBI-20 validation split using the same model scores as in the retrieval evaluation. For each query, the paired ground-truth candidate was removed from the ranking, and the next top-ranked candidates were treated as non-exact neighbours. In Text-to-Molecule retrieval, Tanimoto similarity was computed between the molecule paired with the query text and each retrieved molecule. In Molecule-to-Text retrieval, each retrieved text was mapped back to its paired molecule and compared with the query molecule.
blocks.zh: 为了检验检索收益是否与化学上更接近的非精确邻居相对应,我们用与检索评价中相同的模型分数,对CHEBI-20验证分解进行了排除-自身结构-邻居分析. 对于每个查询,配对的地面真人候选人都被从排名中删除,接下来排名最高的候选人被作为非准确邻居对待. 在Text-to-Molecule检索中,Tanimoto在与查询文本对齐的分子与每个检索分子之间计算出相似性. 在分子对图文检索中,每个检索到的文本被映射回其配对分子,并与查询分子进行比较.

blocks.en: All structural similarities in this analysis used Morgan fingerprints with radius 2 and 2,048 bits. For each query and cutoff K ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 } K\in\{1,2,3\} , we computed the mean Tanimoto similarity of the top- K K non-exact neighbours, and aggregate displays report the mean and per-query distributions of these values. Paired differences between SAGA and the baseline were assessed with a one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test, using the alternative hypothesis that SAGA retrieves structurally closer neighbours. We also report the fraction of queries for which the SAGA top-3 mean Tanimoto similarity exceeds the corresponding baseline value.

For the per-query scatter analysis, each point corresponds to one validation query, with the horizontal and vertical coordinates given by the baseline and SAGA top-3 mean Tanimoto similarities, respectively. Point colour encodes the signed, log-scaled improvement in the exact target rank. Representative retrieval examples were selected from queries in which SAGA retrieved high-Tanimoto neighbours while the baseline retrieved low-Tanimoto neighbours, and are used only as illustrative examples. Description-level text-overlap displays in the Supplementary Information use the same top-3 non-exact neighbours. Red annotations mark structural-class terms shared with the query description; these annotations are qualitative aids and are not used in the quantitative Tanimoto or statistical analyses.
blocks.zh: 对于每点散射分析,每个点对应一个验证查询,基线给出的横向坐标和垂直坐标,SAGA顶-3分别表示田本的相似性. 点颜色编码了所签名的,日志尺度的精确目标等级改进. 从SAGA检索高塔尼本邻居而基线检索低塔尼本邻居的查询中选取了代表性检索实例,仅用作示例。 补充信息中的描述级文本重叠显示使用相同的顶-3非精确邻. 红色注释标记与查询描述共享的结构类名词;这些注释是定性辅助词,不用于定量的田本或统计分析.

blocks.en: 3.10 Molecular property prediction evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.10 分子财产预测评价

blocks.en: We use eight classification datasets from the MoleculeNet benchmark 21 : BBBP, HIV, and BACE are single-label binary classification, while Tox21 (12 labels), ToxCast (617), SIDER (27), ClinTox (2), and MUV (17) are multi-label tasks in which each label corresponds to an independent bioassay endpoint. All datasets follow the scaffold split recommended by the benchmark, which provides a more realistic assessment of out-of-distribution generalization than random splits.
blocks.zh: 我们使用来自MoleculeNet基准21的8个分类数据集:BBBP,HIV,和BACE是单标签二进制分类,而Tox21(12个标签),ToxCast(617),SIDER(27),ClinTox(2)和MUV(17)是多标签任务,每个标签对应一个独立的生物测定端点. 所有数据集都遵循基准推荐的脚手架拆分,比随机拆分更现实地评估分配外的泛化.

blocks.en: To feed a single fixed-dimensional vector into the probe, we extract a pooled molecular embedding from each frozen encoder following the pooling convention of the original model. For MolCA, we mean-pool over the eight Q-Former query tokens to obtain a 768-dimensional graph embedding. For Atomas, a learned linear layer aggregates the SMILES token sequence into a single vector which is then L 2 L_{2} -normalized, yielding a 768-dimensional embedding for Atomas-B and a 1024-dimensional embedding for Atomas-L (matching the native hidden size of the underlying MolT5 27 encoder).
blocks.zh: 为了给探测器输入一个固定维的矢量, 我们从每个冷冻编码器中提取一个集合分子嵌入物, 遵循原始模型的集合协议。 对于MOLCA来说,我们是指在8个Q-Former查询符上集合,以获得768维的图形嵌入. 对 Atomas 来说,一个有学识的线性层将 SMILES 符号序列聚合成一个单一的矢量,然后是 L 2 L_{2} - 正常化,生成 Atomas- B 的 768 维嵌入, Atomas- L 的 1024 维嵌入(匹配基础 Molt5 27 编码器的原生隐藏大小) 。

blocks.en: To evaluate the quality of the learned representations independently of the pre-training objective, we freeze the molecular encoder and train only a lightweight 2-layer MLP classification head on top of the pooled embedding. The head applies a linear projection to a 256-dimensional hidden representation, followed by LayerNorm, a GELU activation, dropout with p = 0.1 p=0.1 , and a final linear layer mapping to the task output. No part of the encoder is fine-tuned; only the MLP parameters are updated.
blocks.zh: 为了独立于训练前目标来评价所学表现的质量,我们冻结了分子编码器,并在集合嵌入器上方只训练一个轻量级的2级MLP分类头. 头部将线性投影应用到256维的隐藏表现上,然后是TyleNorm,一个GELU激活,以p = 0.1 p = 0.1的退出,以及任务输出的最终线性层映射. 编码器中没有任何部分被微调;只有MLP参数被更新.

blocks.en: We train for 25 epochs using AdamW (initial learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} , weight decay 0.01 0.01 ) with a ReduceLROnPlateau scheduler (factor 0.5, patience 5, minimum learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} ) that monitors validation ROC-AUC. The batch size is 32. We use binary cross-entropy with logits as the loss for both single-label and multi-label tasks, computed independently per label. Performance is reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation of ROC-AUC over 5 random seeds; for multi-label datasets, the per-label AUROCs are averaged to obtain the reported score.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 AdamW(初始学习率 10 - 3 10 - 3 - 3), 重量衰减 0.01 0.01) 来训练25个时代, 配备一个LindLROnPlateau 排程器(系数 0.5, 耐心 5, 最低学习率 10 - 4 10 - 4) 来监测 ROC - AUC的验证。 批量尺寸为32. 我们使用二进制的横切式和对数作为单标签和多标签任务的损失,每个标签独立计算。 性能报告为ROC-AUC在5个随机种子上的平均值±\pm标准差;对于多标签数据集,每个标签的AUROCs平均得到报告的分数.

blocks.en: 3.11 Molecular generation and description evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.11 分子生成和描述评价

blocks.en: Generation experiments use the native fine-tuning and decoding protocols of the corresponding backbone. Text-to-molecule generation is evaluated only for Atomas, whose original framework supports SMILES generation from text, whereas molecule-to-text description generation is evaluated for MolCA and Atomas. In Atomas, the genmol and gentext tasks are fine-tuned separately from the corresponding task-specific baseline or SAGA-pretrained initialization. The values reported in Table 3 are single-run results.
blocks.zh: 生成实验使用对应骨干原生的微调和解码协议. 文本到分子生成只评价Atomas,其原始框架支持从文本生成SMILES,而分子到文字描述生成则评价MolyCA和Atomas. 在阿托马斯语中,genmol和gentext任务与相应的任务特定基线或SAGA预设初始化分别进行微调. 表3中报告的数值是单运行结果。

blocks.en: For the MolCA description-generation runs, we use the ChEBI-20 train/validation/test split and fine-tune the Galactica-1.3B language model with LoRA adapters following the original MolCA stage-2 recipe. The run reported in Table 3 uses micro-batches of 16 with gradient accumulation of 4, corresponding to an effective batch size of 64, for 100 fine-tuning epochs. Captions are decoded on the ChEBI-20 test split (3,300 molecule-description pairs) with beam search using five beams and no sampling. We report BLEU-2, BLEU-4, ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L, multiplied by 100, using the original MolCA caption-evaluation implementation.
blocks.zh: 对于MOLCA描述-生成运行,我们使用CHEBI-20列车/验证/测试拆分,并按照原MOLCA阶段-2配方与LORA适配器微调卡拉狄加-1.3B语言模型. 表3中报告的运行使用16个梯度积分为4的微波波段,相当于有效批量尺寸64,用于100个微调时段。 说明在ChEBI-20测试分解(3300分子描述对)上解码,用五束进行光束搜索,没有采样. 我们报告BLEU-2、BLEU-4、ROUGE-1、ROUGE-2和ROUGE-L,乘以100,使用最初的MOLCA标题评价执行情况。

blocks.en: For the Atomas description-generation runs, we fine-tune the original Atomas Base and Large models on ChEBI-20 with the gentext objective, using the SMILES encoder output as the conditioning signal for text generation. Fine-tuning itself follows the native Atomas recipe and does not add a fingerprint-based CKA loss; the SAGA condition is instead initialized from the corresponding fingerprint-CKA-pretrained checkpoint. The description-generation SAGA checkpoint uses Morgan fingerprints with a fingerprint queue size of 128 and λ = 1000 \lambda=1000 during pre-training. Atomas caption metrics are computed on the ChEBI-20 validation split with the original Atomas text-translation evaluator, using SciBERT tokenization for BLEU-2/4 and ROUGE-1/2/L F-measures. These metrics are multiplied by 100 in Table 3 .
blocks.zh: 对于Atomas描述-生成运行,我们用gentext目标微调了ChEBI-20上原有的Atomas Base和大模型,将SMILES编码器输出作为文本生成的调制信号. 精细调整本身遵循原生的Atomas食谱,不增加基于指纹的CKA损失;SAGA条件则从相应的指纹-CKA预先训练的检查站初始化. 描述生成的SAGA检查站使用摩根指纹,指纹排队尺寸为128,XQ=1000\lambda=1000在预训期间. Atomas 字幕度量衡是在与原Atomas 文本翻译评审员的ChEBI-20验证分解上计算出来的,使用SciBERT的编号来表示BLEU-2/4和ROUGE-1/2/L F-度量衡. 表3中的这些指标乘以100。

blocks.en: For Atomas text-to-molecule generation, Base and Large variants are fine-tuned separately with the native genmol objective and evaluated on the ChEBI-20 validation split. The SAGA-pretrained initialization uses Morgan fingerprints with a fingerprint queue size of 128 and λ = 100 \lambda=100 ; this setting is distinct from the Atomas description-generation checkpoint. We report BLEU, exact-match rate, Levenshtein distance, MACCS, RDKit and Morgan fingerprint Tanimoto similarity (FTS), and chemical validity. BLEU is computed over character-tokenized SMILES strings. Exact match is computed after conversion of generated and reference SMILES to InChI strings, Levenshtein is the mean SMILES edit distance, chemical validity is the fraction of generated SMILES parsed by RDKit, and FTS metrics are mean Tanimoto similarities between generated and reference molecules using the corresponding fingerprint family. Bounded metrics are multiplied by 100 in Table 3 , whereas Levenshtein distance is reported on its raw scale.
blocks.zh: 对于Atomas的文本对分子生成,Base和大变体与原生的基因摩尔目标分别进行微调,并在ChEBI-20验证分解上进行评估. SAGA预装初始化使用Morgan指纹,指纹队列大小为128,QQ=100\lambda=100;此设置与Atomas描述生成检查站不同. 我们报告BLEU、精确比比率、莱文施泰因距离、MACCS、RDKit和摩根指纹Tanimoto的相似性以及化学有效性。 BLEU是通过字符键化的SMILES字符串计算出来的. 精确匹配是在将生成的SMILES转换为InChI字符串后计算出来的,莱文什泰因是平均值的SMILES编辑距离,化学有效性是RDKit解析生成的SMILES的一小部分,FTS度量衡是使用相应的指纹家族生成的和参考分子之间的平均值田本相似. 在表3中,边界指标乘以100,而莱文施泰因的距离则按原始规模报告。

blocks.en: 3.12 Representation space analysis
blocks.zh: 3.12 代表空间分析

blocks.en: To assess how SAGA reshapes the learned embedding space, we employ two complementary clustering schemes that capture different aspects of molecular structure. For Tanimoto-based clustering , we compute pairwise Tanimoto distances from Morgan fingerprints and apply agglomerative hierarchical clustering with Ward linkage, cutting the dendrogram to yield 10 clusters. This data-driven grouping reflects the same fingerprint similarity structure used during training and thus serves as a direct measure of how well the learned representations preserve the intended structural prior. For scaffold-based clustering , we extract Murcko scaffolds 28 —core ring systems obtained by removing side chains—and retain the 10 most frequent scaffolds as cluster labels, excluding molecules belonging to rarer scaffolds. Because scaffold identity is not used during training, this grouping provides an independent assessment of whether structural organization generalizes beyond the training signal. Scaffold frequencies in the evaluation set are heavily long-tailed, with several of the 10 retained scaffolds containing fewer than 20 molecules; such small clusters introduce instability in Silhouette and Calinski–Harabasz estimation. For quantitative scaffold-based metrics (Supplementary Table 4) we therefore retain only scaffolds with at least 20 samples, while the t-SNE visualization in Fig. 4 d continues to display the top 10 scaffolds for completeness. Embeddings are projected to two dimensions via t-SNE 29 (perplexity = 30) for visualization only; all quantitative metrics are computed in the original high-dimensional embedding space.
blocks.zh: 为了评估SAGA如何重塑所学到的嵌入空间,我们采用了两个能捕捉分子结构不同方面的互补集群方案. 对于以田本为基础的集群,我们计算出田本与摩根指纹的对比距离,并应用与沃德连结的格格分级集群,剪切dendrogram以产生10个集群. 这种数据驱动的分组反映了培训期间使用的相同指纹相似性结构,从而直接衡量所学表现如何保持了预定结构的前身。 对于基于脚手架的集群,我们提取了Murcko的二十八号脚手架——通过去除侧链而获得的核心环系统——并保留最常见的十号脚手架作为集群标签,不包括属于稀有脚手架的分子. 由于脚手架身份在训练期间没有被使用,因此这个分组提供了对结构组织是否超越训练信号进行概括的独立评估. 评估组中的脚手架频率严重长尾,在保留下来的10个脚手架中,有数个含有不到20分子的;这种小集群在Silhouette和Calinski–Harabasz估计中带来不稳定. 因此,对于基于脚手架的量化度量衡(补充表4),我们只保留至少有20个样本的脚手架,而T-SNE可视化在Fig中. 4d继续显示前十名脚手架的完整性. 通过t-SNE 29(复杂度=30)将嵌入到两个维度上,仅用于可视化;所有量化度量度均在原高维嵌入空间中计算.

blocks.en: We quantify the representation space along two axes: alignment between representation spaces via CKA, and clustering quality under a given label assignment via Silhouette and Calinski–Harabasz indices. CKA is computed with the same Gram matrix construction as in the training objective (Section 3.4 ): a Tanimoto kernel for fingerprints (Eq. 1 ) and a linear kernel over L 2 L_{2} -normalized embeddings for neural representations. For post-hoc analysis we use the biased HSIC estimator rather than the unbiased variant of Eq. ( 3 ), as biased centering is the standard convention for CKA reporting 17 and small-sample variance is less of a concern in the offline evaluation regime.
blocks.zh: 我们沿着两个轴线量化代表空间:通过CKA调整代表空间,通过Silhouette和Calinski-Harabasz指数将质量归集到特定标签分配下。 CKA的计算采用与培训目标(第3.4节)相同的Gram矩阵结构:一个用于指纹的Tanimoto内核(Eq. 1)和一个L 2 L_{2}上的线性内核——用于神经表达的正常嵌入。 对于事后分析,我们使用偏颇的HSIC估计器而不是Eq. (3)的无偏见变体,因为偏颇的中心是CKA报告17的标准公约,而小样本差异在离线评价制度中则不那么令人关切。

blocks.en: All source datasets analysed in this study are publicly available. The 20 ADMET benchmark datasets were obtained from the Therapeutics Data Commons (TDC, https://tdcommons.ai ) 18 . The pre-training corpus was assembled from PubChem following the data collection pipeline of Atomas 13 ; processing details are described in the Methods. Cross-modal retrieval and generation experiments used ChEBI-20 7 , and molecular property prediction used MoleculeNet 21 . Text embeddings for the CKA analysis were obtained from OpenAI’s text-embedding-3-small API 26 (accessed December 2025). Processed outputs and source data underlying the figures and tables will be made available to editors and reviewers through a private reviewer-access repository at https://github.com/February24-Lee/SAGA.git during peer review and will be deposited in a public archive upon publication.

blocks.en: Supplementary Note 1. Sensitivity analyses
blocks.zh: 补充说明 1. 敏感性分析

blocks.en: We evaluated the regularization weight λ \lambda for all three backbones to determine whether the structural prior has a stable operating range. MolCA showed an inverted-U response: retrieval improved as λ \lambda increased to 100, but decreased at λ = 1000 \lambda=1000 , indicating that an overly strong structural constraint can interfere with the primary molecule–text objective. Atomas-B also benefited most around λ = 100 \lambda=100 , whereas Atomas-L remained robust at larger weights. These trends support the use of λ = 100 \lambda=100 as a shared default for the main experiments, while showing that model capacity affects how much structural prior can be absorbed.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了所有三个主干线的规范化权重 确定结构前端是否有稳定的运行范围。 MollCA显示反向U反应:由于QQ\lambda增加到100,检索得到改进,但在QQ = 1000\lambda= 1000时下降,表明结构约束过强会干扰主分子–文本目标. Atomas-B也受益最多, 这些趋势支持使用QQ=100\lambda=100作为主实验的共享默认,同时表明模型容量会影响之前可吸收多少结构.

blocks.en: The fingerprint ablation tests whether the structural target must be compatible with the molecular encoder. Morgan fingerprints performed best for MolCA, consistent with the graph encoder’s emphasis on local atom neighborhoods. MACCS keys performed better for both Atomas variants, consistent with a SMILES encoder that is more directly exposed to functional-group patterns. RDKit topological fingerprints were weaker across models and degraded MolCA, suggesting that path-based similarity provides a less compatible relational target for the molecule–language objectives evaluated here.
blocks.zh: 指纹衰减测试结构目标是否必须与分子编码器兼容. Morgan指纹对MOLCA的表现最好, MACCS密钥对Atomas两个变体都表现较好,与SMILES编码器一致,它更直接暴露在功能组模式中. RDKit的地形指纹在模型中较弱,MolyCA也退化,这表明基于路径的相似性为本文评价的分子语言目标提供了不太兼容的关系目标。

blocks.en: The CKA sample size n n controls how many molecules define the relational alignment target. In MolCA, n n is tied to the training batch size, whereas in Atomas it is decoupled through the fingerprint queue. Moderate sample sizes were most effective: MolCA retained a stable relative gain across batch sizes, and both Atomas variants performed best around n = 128 n=128 . Very large CKA samples reduced the gain, especially for Atomas-B, suggesting that overly detailed pairwise targets can become difficult for smaller encoders to absorb.
blocks.zh: CKA样本大小 n 控制了多少分子定义关系对齐目标. 在MOLCA中,nn与训练批量大小相连,而在Atomas中则通过指纹队列解开. 适度的样本规模最为有效: MOLA在批量尺寸上保持稳定的相对收益,两个Atomas变体在n=128n=128左右表现最好. 极大的CKA样本降低了增益,特别是对Atomas-B来说,这表明过于详细的对偶目标可能很难让较小的编码器吸收.

blocks.en: Supplementary Note 2. Representation-space analyses
blocks.zh: 补充说明 2. 代表空间分析

blocks.en: The representation analyses quantify how SAGA changes the geometry of molecule and text embeddings after training. Across all backbones, molecule–fingerprint CKA increased, showing that the learned molecular representation became more aligned with fingerprint-derived structural relationships. This reorganization also propagated to the text side through contrastive training: text–fingerprint CKA increased even though the CKA loss was applied only to molecular representations. Molecule–text CKA remained stable or improved for MolCA and Atomas-L, and changed only marginally for Atomas-B, indicating that the added structural organization does not disrupt cross-modal alignment.
blocks.zh: 表述分析量化了SAGA如何在训练后改变分子和文字嵌入的几何. 在所有骨干中,分子-指印CKA都有所增加,这表明所学的分子表现与指纹衍生的结构关系更加一致。 这种重组也通过对比性培训传播到文本方面:文本-指印CKA增加,尽管CKA损失只适用于分子表达。 Molecule-text CKA对于MOLCA和Atomas-L来说保持稳定或改进,对于Atomas-B来说仅略有改变,表明新增的结构组织不会破坏跨模式的对齐。

blocks.en: Representation-space trends mirrored the retrieval sensitivity analyses. Increasing λ \lambda generally increased molecule–fingerprint alignment and cluster separation, but for MolCA the highest weight produced a representation that was more structurally organized while retrieval declined, consistent with over-constraining the embedding geometry. Fingerprint effects also followed the encoder split: Morgan produced the cleanest MolCA clustering, whereas MACCS produced stronger Atomas alignment and clustering metrics.
blocks.zh: 代表空间的趋势反映了检索敏感性分析。 增加 \ lambda 通常会增加分子 – 指纹对齐和集群分离, 但对于 MOLCA 来说, 最高的重量产生了一种结构上更有序的表示, 而回收量下降, 与嵌入几何的过度约束一致 。 指纹效应也跟随编码器分裂:摩根生产出最干净的MolyCA集群,而MACCS则生产出更强的Atomas对齐和集群度量衡.

blocks.en: To test whether the learned organization extends beyond the exact fingerprint-similarity target, we also evaluated clustering by Murcko scaffold identity. Scaffold labels are not used in the SAGA objective, yet scaffold-based Calinski–Harabasz and Silhouette scores improved across all three backbones. Because scaffold frequencies in ChEBI-20 are long-tailed, Supplementary Table 4 reports both top-10 scaffold results and a filtered setting that removes very small clusters.
blocks.zh: 为了检验学习的组织是否超越了精确的指纹-相似性目标,我们也通过Murcko脚手架身份来评价集群. 脚手架的标签并没有在SAGA目标中使用,然而基于脚手架的Calinski–Harabasz和Silhouette在所有三个骨干上的分数都有改善. 由于ChEBI-20中的脚手架频率是长尾的,补充表4既报告了前10级脚手架的结果,也报告了一个可以去除极小集群的过滤设置.

blocks.en: Supplementary Note 3. Molecular generation and description experiments
blocks.zh: 补充说明 3. 分子生成和描述实验

blocks.en: Generation experiments were conducted on ChEBI-20 using the native fine-tuning and decoding protocols of each backbone. The ablation compares each baseline with the corresponding SAGA-pretrained initialization. MolCA supports molecule-to-text description generation, whereas Atomas supports both molecule-to-text description generation and text-to-molecule SMILES generation. All generation values reported in the main text are single-run results rather than averages over repeated seeds.
blocks.zh: 在CHEBI-20上利用每个主干线的原生微调和解码协议进行了生成实验. 将每个基准与相应的SAGA预装初始化进行比较。 MoloCA支持分子到文字描述生成,而Atomas则支持分子到文字描述生成和文本到分子的SMILES生成. 主文中所报告的所有生成值都是单运行结果,而不是重复种子的平均值.

blocks.en: For MolCA, baseline and SAGA stage-1 checkpoints were used to initialize the original stage-2 ChEBI-20 description-generation recipe. The Galactica-1.3B language model was fine-tuned with LoRA adapters using micro-batches of 16 and gradient accumulation of 4, corresponding to an effective batch size of 64, for 100 fine-tuning epochs. Evaluation used the ChEBI-20 test split with 3,300 molecule-description pairs. Captions were decoded with beam search using five beams and no sampling. The MolCA evaluator computes BLEU-2, BLEU-4, ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L values on a 0–100 scale; these are the metrics shown in the main generation table.
blocks.zh: 对于MOLCA,使用了基线和SAGA第1级检查站来初始化原第2级CHEBI-20描述生成配方. 卡拉狄加-1.3B语言模型与LORA适配器进行了微调,采用了16的微巴和4的梯度堆积,对应有效的批量尺寸64,用于100个微调时段. 评价采用ChEBI-20测试拆分法,3300分子描述对. 说明用五根梁进行梁式搜索,不作取样。 MOLCA评价器计算出BLEU-2,BLEU-4,ROUGE-1,ROUGE-2和ROUGE-L值为0-100;这些是主生成表中显示的度量衡.

blocks.en: Atomas description generation used the native gentext task, in which the SMILES encoder output conditions text generation. Atomas Base and Large were fine-tuned separately from the corresponding task-specific baseline or SAGA-pretrained checkpoint. Fine-tuning itself did not include the fingerprint-based CKA loss; the SAGA condition differs from the baseline by initialization from a fingerprint-CKA-pretrained checkpoint. For these description-generation runs, the SAGA pre-training checkpoint used Morgan fingerprints, a fingerprint queue size of 128 and λ = 1000 \lambda=1000 . Metrics were computed on the ChEBI-20 validation split using the original Atomas text-translation evaluator with SciBERT tokenization for BLEU-2/4 and ROUGE-1/2/L F-measures. The Atomas evaluator returns values on a 0–1 scale, which were multiplied by 100 for the main table.
blocks.zh: Atomas 描述生成使用了本地 gentext 任务, 其中 SMILES 编码器输出条件为文本生成 。 Atomas Base和Lige与相应的任务基准或SAGA预先训练的检查站分别进行了微调。 微调本身不包括基于指纹的CKA损失;SAGA条件与基线不同,它与指纹-CKA预先训练的检查站初始化。 对于这些描述生成运行,SAGA预训检查点使用摩根指纹,指纹排队大小为128,QQ=1000\lambda=1000. 在ChEBI-20验证分数上,使用原始的Atomas文本翻译评估器计算出BLEU-2/4和ROUGE-1/2/L F计量的SciBERT标识。 Atomas 评价员在0-1尺度上返回数值,主表乘以100。

blocks.en: Atomas text-to-molecule generation used the native genmol task and was fine-tuned separately from the gentext task. Base and Large variants were evaluated on the ChEBI-20 validation split. The SAGA-pretrained initialization for genmol used Morgan fingerprints, a fingerprint queue size of 128 and λ = 100 \lambda=100 , which is distinct from the gentext checkpoint described above. SMILES-generation metrics follow the Atomas/MolT5 evaluator: BLEU is computed over character-tokenized SMILES strings; exact match is computed after converting generated and reference SMILES to InChI strings; Levenshtein is the mean SMILES edit distance; validity is the fraction of generated SMILES strings parsed by RDKit; and MACCS, RDKit and Morgan FTS values are mean Tanimoto similarities between generated and reference molecules using the corresponding fingerprint family. In the main table, BLEU, exact match, FTS and validity are multiplied by 100, whereas Levenshtein distance is reported on its raw scale.
blocks.zh: Atomas 文本到分子生成使用了原生的genmol任务,并与 gentext 任务分开进行微调. 在CHEBI-20验证分解上评价了基和大变种. Genmol的SAGA预训初始化使用了Morgan指纹,指纹队列尺寸为128和QQ=100\lambda=100,与上述gentext检查站不同. SMILES生成度量衡跟随Atomas/MolT5评价器:BLEU是在字符键化的SMILES字符串上计算出来的;在将生成的SMILES转换为InChiI字符串后计算出精确的匹配度;Levenshtein是平均的SMILES编辑距离;有效性是RDKit解析生成的SMILES字符串的一小部分;MACCS,RDKit和Morgan FTS值是使用相应指纹家族的生成和参考分子之间的平均Tanimoto相似度. 在主表中,BLEU,精确匹配,FTS和有效性乘以100,而莱文施泰因的距离则按原始尺度报告.
